title: Create and use a session-only schema without migrations on MySQL

scope.database: Disposable MySQL; connection via ZTD_MYSQL_HOST, ZTD_MYSQL_PORT, ZTD_MYSQL_DB, ZTD_MYSQL_USER, ZTD_MYSQL_PASSWORD
scope.setup: Empty disposable database; the script never creates a physical table. Table names are random per adapter so parallel runs do not collide. Runtime versions are emitted by the script.
